meaning.hi: अतिमूढ़ प्रत्यपत्ति चाहे, कल्पकोटि में भी गति नहीं दिखती

words.sanskrit: tyaktva sarva ashraman dhirah vaset moksha ashrame chiram

meaning.en: the steady one, setting aside all stages, dwells long in the liberation stage
meaning.hi: धीर सब आश्रम त्यागकर मोक्षाश्रम में चिरकाल रहे

words.sanskrit: moksha ashramat paribhrashtah na gatih tasya vidyate

meaning.en: one who falls from the liberation stage finds no path
meaning.hi: मोक्षाश्रम से भ्रष्ट की कोई गति नहीं होती

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: parivrajyam grihitva tu yah svadharme na tishthati

meaning.en: one who takes up renunciation but does not remain steadfast in its duty
meaning.hi: परिव्राज्य ग्रहण कर स्वधर्म में न टिकने वाला

words.sanskrit: tam arudha chyutam vidyat iti veda anushasanam

meaning.en: should be known as one who climbed and fell, thus the Vedic instruction
meaning.hi: उसे आरूढ़च्युत जानें, यह वेदानुशासन है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sanatanam atma dharmam vaishnavim nishtham labdhva yah tam adushayan vartate sah vashi bhavati

meaning.en: one who attains this eternal self-duty and lives without corrupting it becomes self-mastered
meaning.hi: सनातन आत्मधर्म वैष्णवी निष्ठा पाकर अदूषित रहने वाला वशी बनता है

words.sanskrit: sah punya shlokah lokajnah vedanta jnah brahma jnah sarvajnah svarat bhavati

meaning.en: he becomes of good repute, world-wise, Vedanta-learned, Brahman-knower, all-knowing, sovereign
meaning.hi: वह पुण्यश्लोक, लोकज्ञ, वेदांतज्ञ, ब्रह्मज्ञ, सर्वज्ञ, स्वराट् बनता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sah param brahma bhagavantam apnoti sah pitrin sambandhinah bandhavan suhridah mitrani cha bhava uttarayati

meaning.en: he reaches the Supreme Brahman and carries ancestors, kin, friends across
meaning.hi: वह परब्रह्म भगवान को पाता है और पितृ-बांधव-मित्रों को तारता है

words.sanskrit: shatam kulanam prathamam babhuva tatha paranam trishatam samagram

meaning.en: a hundred families first, then three hundred more in full
meaning.hi: पहले सौ कुल, फिर पूरे तीन सौ और

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: trimshat parah trimshat aparan trimshat cha paratah paran

meaning.en: thirty beyond, thirty more, and thirty further still are carried across
meaning.hi: तीस परे, तीस और, तीस उनसे भी परे

words.sanskrit: uttarayati dharmishthah parivrat iti vai shrutih

meaning.en: the righteous wanderer carries them across, thus the tradition declares
meaning.hi: धर्मिष्ठ परिव्राट् तारता है, यह श्रुति है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sannyastam iti yah bruyat kantha stha pranavan api

meaning.en: whoever declares themselves renounced, even with just a thread of breath left
meaning.hi: जो संन्यस्त कहे, कंठस्थ प्राण वाला भी

words.sanskrit: taritah pitarah tena iti veda anushasanam

meaning.en: by this, the ancestors are carried across, thus the Vedic instruction
meaning.hi: उससे पितर तारे जाते हैं, यह वेदानुशासन है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sanatanam atma dharmam vaishnavim nishtham na asamapya prabruyat

meaning.en: this eternal self-duty, the Vaishnava commitment, should not be declared complete prematurely
meaning.hi: सनातन आत्मधर्म वैष्णवी निष्ठा असमाप्त न कहें

words.sanskrit: na anuchanaya na anatmavide na avitaragaya na avishuddhaya na anupasannaya na aprayata manasaya

meaning.en: not to the unlearned, self-ignorant, passion-bound, impure, disrespectful, or unsettled mind
meaning.hi: अनूचान, अनात्मवित्, अवीतराग, अविशुद्ध, अनुपसन्न, अप्रयतमानस को नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: vidya ha vai brahmanam ajagama gopaya mam shevadhih te aham asmi

meaning.en: knowledge came to the Brahmin saying, guard me, I am your treasure
meaning.hi: विद्या ब्राह्मण के पास आई, मुझे रक्षो, मैं तुम्हारा निधि हूँ

words.sanskrit: asuyakaya anrijave shathaya ma ma bruyah viryavati tatha syam

meaning.en: do not reveal me to the envious, dishonest, or deceitful, that I remain powerful
meaning.hi: असूयक, अनृजु, शठ को मत कहो, तभी मैं वीर्यवती रहूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yam eva vidya shrutam apramattam medhavinam brahmacharya upapannam

meaning.en: one who has heard the teaching, undistracted, intelligent, disciplined in study
meaning.hi: जो विद्याश्रुत, अप्रमत्त, मेधावी, ब्रह्मचर्ययुक्त हो

words.sanskrit: asmai imam upasannaya samyak parikshya dadyat vaishnavim atma nishtham

meaning.en: to that approaching student, after careful examination, give this self-abiding Vaishnava teaching
meaning.hi: उसे सम्यक् परीक्षा कर वैष्णवी आत्मनिष्ठा दें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: adhyapitah ye gurum na adriyante viprah vacha manasa karmana va

meaning.en: the learned who do not honor the teacher by speech, mind, or action
meaning.hi: जो विप्र वाणी-मन-कर्म से गुरु का आदर नहीं करते

words.sanskrit: tatha eva cha anam na bhunakti shrutam tat

meaning.en: in that same way, they do not receive the nourishment of what was heard
meaning.hi: वैसे ही श्रुत का अन्न नहीं भोगते

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: gurah eva parah dharmah gurah eva para gatih

meaning.en: the teacher alone is the highest righteousness and the highest destination
meaning.hi: गुरु ही परम धर्म है, गुरु ही परम गति है

words.sanskrit: tasya shrutam tatha jnanam sravati amaghata ambuvat

meaning.en: his learning and knowledge leak away like water from a broken vessel
meaning.hi: उसका श्रुत-ज्ञान टूटे घड़े के जल-सा बह जाता है

words.sanskrit: yasya deve para bhaktih yatha deve tatha gurau

meaning.en: whoever has supreme devotion to God, and the same to the teacher
meaning.hi: जिसकी देव में परा भक्ति है, वैसी ही गुरु में

words.sanskrit: sah brahma vit param preyat iti veda anushasanam

meaning.en: that person reaches the highest Brahman-knowledge, thus the Vedic instruction
meaning.hi: वह ब्रह्मविद् परम को पाता है, यह वेदानुशासन है
